snippet.title: Attack on Titan 3 - Gameplay Reveal Trailer | Releasing 12/10/2026
snippet.description:
https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/attackontitan3/us/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=PV2USV2&utm_id=Caption

Attack on Titan 3 is coming to PlayStation®5, Nintendo Switch™ 2, XBOX Series X|S and Steam® on December 10th 2026.

Pre-Order and Wishlist:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012189
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2916700/Attack_on_Titan_3__AOT_3/

Begin – for the Farewell

Attack on Titan 3 is the riveting culmination of the action game series, depicting the story of Attack on Titan from its survey corp beginnings to its dramatic conclusion.

The opening animation for the game* will be produced by MAPPA, the animation studio that worked on Attack on Titan: The Final Season, with action scene animator, storyboard artist, and key animator Arifumi Imai returning as director.  Stay tuned for more information and future reveals!
* The opening animation will not be implemented at the time of release, but will be added to the game in a future update.

Official X: https://x.com/kt_shingeki_EN

Platforms: PlayStation®5 / Nintendo Switch™ 2 / XBOX Series X|S / Steam®
